answer: Disjoint Route Admission Rule. Each new agent must show k paths with non-overlapping neighbor sets and latency profiles. A sybil cluster collapses into a karst of redundant routes, so admission rejects it. Echo patterns from repeated relay hops trigger rechecks. A prism comparison checks independent path signatures. An attacker pays per identity by running dispersed relays with distinct latency and neighbors; shared infrastructure fails disjointness and wastes setup cost.
